summary_en: FY5/26 final dividend: 52 yen/share (273M yen total), unchanged from prior forecast, up from 48 yen/share in FY5/25. FY5/27 dividend forecast: 65 yen/share (57 yen ordinary + 8 yen commemorative), reflecting 40th anniversary recognition. Both full-year payouts (no interim dividend planned). Policy: stable dividend expansion tied to sustained enterprise value growth.
title_en: Notice regarding dividend of surplus for fiscal year ending May 2026 and dividend forecast for fiscal year ending May 2027 (including commemorative dividend)
translation_en_brief: Pacific Net Co., Ltd. announced on 15 July 2026 that its board has approved a final dividend for fiscal year ending 31 May 2026 of 52 yen per share (273 million yen total), to be submitted to the 38th annual shareholders' meeting scheduled for 27 August 2026. This represents no change from the forecast issued on 14 April 2026 and a 4-yen increase from the prior year's 48 yen per share. The ex-dividend date is 31 May 2026, with payment scheduled for 28 August 2026. The company also announced a dividend forecast for fiscal year ending 31 May 2027 of 65 yen per share, comprising 57 yen in ordinary dividend and 8 yen in commemorative dividend. The company stated that it will pay only a final dividend (no interim dividend) in both periods. The rationale emphasizes the company's commitment to continuous enterprise value growth and stable dividend expansion. The commemorative dividend reflects the company's 40th anniversary, which it will mark in July 2027, as gratitude to shareholders for their support.
